title: Quality Of Life - Datapack
description: More Recipes for Quality of Life!
body:
This is a "DataPack" to make things craftable and easier to obtain. This can go from
Chainmail Armor to Player Heads to Skulls. Raw Ore Blocks to Ore Blocks via Blast Furnace.
Any additions will be added as Quality of Life, to make steps easier, or just to
make it more easy on building and collecting!
